<!-- pr-reviewer: f1bbbee614d5ec580c60e173cb838af5b2288ff8 -->
Reviewed at head f1bbbee614 (merge-ready kept). Built locally in a worktree, merged with current main. The merge is clean.

**Result: clean.**

Pointed checks I ran myself:
- `break_through` 12/12, `project_roundtrip` 73/73, `mcp` 22/22, `drilling_axial` 7/7, `drill_reach` 6/6, `operations` 120/126 (6 ignored, as on main), `posting` 17/17, `camcraft-sim` all green, ui lib `guide_projects` 2/2.
- Math: Ø6 at 118 degrees gives 3 / tan(59 deg) = 1.8026. With `break_through` 1.0 the run is 2.803. The moved goldens (`Z-2.803`, `Z-14.803`) match.
- Format: v68 raises `PROJECT_VERSION`; a pre-v68 load settles `Tip`, so saved depths and cached paths do not move. `wrong_version_is_refused` passes. The cache key writes `0xB8` for `FullDiameter`, so a switch invalidates the cached path.
- Sim: the `drill` flag batches drill chunks apart from mill chunks; the field and column backends share `op_sdf_tool`. A bad tip angle is refused by name before the cut.
- Lathe axial drills are forced to `Tip` in `generate.rs`; the refusal bound uses the same `through_clear`.

Laws: `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2441` are present. `docs/decisions/2441-drill-point-break-through.md` is in the PR. No Cargo change. UI text is plain. The Levels selector goes through the params command path.

Note for the merge lane: the head commit is class breaking (`test(project)!`, v68). AGENTS.md merges a breaking PR at the next cut. A green run on a main with this PR will confirm the moved example goldens against the guide tests.
